MEA-2.6.boundary_note: Level 1 is met because a safety evaluation with fail-safe testing exists (EV-480). The missing acceptance dates and the unverifiable register count are shortfalls under the level-1 anchor. EV-482 confirms there is no re-test, so level 3 tracking is also absent.
MEA-2.6.failed_clause: Level 2 needs the count of systems with a fail-safe safety evaluation to equal the dated scope register count, and every residual risk to carry an accepting role and a date. EV-481 names the Model Owner but gives no acceptance dates, and the pack names neither the register nor which systems EV-480 covers.

MEA-2.7.boundary_note: The artefact exists but is withheld, so absence is not established and the control cannot score 0. Only the existence of a commissioned exercise (EV-490) is evidenced.
MEA-2.7.failed_clause: The red-team report (CRHP-RT-2026-06) is withheld under legal privilege and its contents are unavailable (EV-491). Adversarial testing, resilience documentation and per-system coverage cannot be verified, and no separate resilience summary exists (EV-492).

MEA-2.8.boundary_note: A dated transparency risk assessment exists (EV-500, 2026-04) covering notice, adverse-action explanation and appeal. It covers CTA only (EV-502). One of the two required artefacts is missing, so level 1.
MEA-2.8.failed_clause: Level 2 needs a separate dated adequacy test of the documentation carried out with the affected population, with findings recorded. No such test is in the pack. EV-501 is approved notice text, not a comprehension test.

MEA-2.9.boundary_note: Level 2 is supported by EV-510 (explanation method and handbook guidance) and EV-511 (validation by adjusters). EV-512 says the guidance is stale since the 2026-07 model refresh, which puts this at the lower edge of level 2. The anchor does not require guidance to be current, so level 1 is not applied.
MEA-2.9.failed_clause: Level 3 needs measured user comprehension and explanation-use rates per release. EV-511 is a one-off 20-case study, with no per-release measurement and no explanation-use rate.

MEA-3.1.boundary_note: Level 1 is met by EV-560, which shows a named owner, a stated monthly cadence and a log with entries. The review-month gap and the incomplete closure records are exactly the gaps the level-1 anchor describes.
MEA-3.1.failed_clause: Level 2 needs minutes for every review month and a named owner and closure date on every emergent risk. Minutes exist for 8 of 9 months (one month skipped with no note), and only 7 of 23 entries have a closure record (EV-562).

MEA-3.2.boundary_note: Level 2 is met: EV-570 documents three alternative methods with their limits, and EV-571 shows two of them used with records.
MEA-3.2.failed_clause: Level 3 needs method-comparison results and stated confidence per hard-to-assess case. The two methods were each used once on different risks (EV-571), no comparison exists, and there is no guidance on choosing between methods (EV-572).

MEA-3.3.boundary_note: The complaint channel with volume (EV-580: 214 items) and the documented appeal process with recorded outcomes (EV-581: 31 appeals, 9 upheld) are present. The missing change-link artefact is the level-1 gap.
MEA-3.3.failed_clause: Level 2 needs a dated record showing that feedback analysis produced a named change or decision. EV-582 says analysis is not linked to system changes in a recorded way.

MEA-4.1.boundary_note: Level 2 is met by EV-590 (tests on replay of production data) and EV-591 (recorded clinical and adjuster input). EV-590 refers to CTA evaluations only.
MEA-4.1.failed_clause: Level 3 needs the lab-to-production performance gap measured and reported. No gap measurement is present, and the vendor benchmark results are not validated against CRHP data (EV-592).

MEA-4.2.boundary_note: Level 2 is supported by EV-600 (two dated 2026-07 reviews) and EV-601 (independence recorded for Internal Audit). The Clinical Advisory Panel includes a member who advises the CTA product team, a conflict that is recorded but weakens the independence evidence.
MEA-4.2.failed_clause: Level 3 needs review coverage and the resolution outcome of disagreements measured. Only two comments leading to re-analysis are noted in minutes (EV-602), and no coverage or resolution metric exists.

MEA-4.3.boundary_note: Level 1 is met by drift monitoring that detected changes (EV-610). EV-613 reports 6 systems with documented change events against 2 declines in EV-610, which is unreconciled. Level 3 would also fail: EV-612 gives medians with no stated target and no named reviewing body.
MEA-4.3.failed_clause: Level 2 needs every change in the dated change log to have a dated root-cause analysis and a recorded corrective action, tied together in the log. EV-611 evidences a fix only for the 2026-08 decline, with no recorded corrective action for the 2026-04 decline. No dated change log is named, and the RCA dates are not given.
